## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Orlando, United States. It starts at 8001 South Orange Blossom Trail, FL.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Imagine a kingdom of color the size of an NFL football field. You're imagining the Crayola Experience!
>
> Discover every shade of fun in this massive Crayola complex with as many as 27 hands-on activities for you and your little artists to enjoy.
>
> Young kids can enjoy a full day of play and learn how crayons are made in a captivating show. Dream up your own crayon creations in fun workshops and watch them come to life.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €31.60. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 59 ratings and 41 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
